full_prompt_en: A square illuminated manuscript image shows a blue winged mythical creature enclosed within an ornate painted frame on tan parchment. A narrow ochre and dark red border defines the inner square, leaving a broad plain paper margin around it. Circular blue-and-gold ornaments anchor the upper corners, while curling spiral forms turn inward at the bottom corners. The space within the border is packed with rust-red, ochre, pale teal, and blue scrollwork, so very little ground remains empty. The creature faces left with a long pointed beak, a small red-ringed eye, and a cluster of reddish hornlike plumes rising behind its head. Its broad blue neck curves down into a rounded chest, where fine tonal marks suggest layered scales or smooth feathers. The largest feature is a raised wing sweeping across the center and right. A strong blue leading edge bends over rows of coral-pink feather bases, and long teal outer feathers stack tightly toward the right border. Dark ink outlines separate each feather, while fine parallel strokes give the wing its volume. Beneath the wing, a compact torso rests on two long blue legs. Clawed feet spread across the bottom edge of the inner frame, one at the left and another reaching toward the right spiral. A curled patterned form at the shoulder and several leaflike blue shapes behind the body add to the ornamental complexity. The body and scrolls overlap without naturalistic depth, filling the square like an interwoven emblem. Illumination is even and flat across the parchment, with local pale highlights and darker ink hatching shaping the creature rather than a single cast shadow. Muted mineral blue is the dominant color, warmed by red-orange feather accents and golden spirals. The surface has fine grain and slight wear, as if pigment has settled into old paper. The overall composition turns an energetic leftward stride into a controlled decorative knot of wing, claw, circle, and curling border.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩绘手抄本图像在黄褐色羊皮纸上，以华丽的绘制边框圈住一头蓝色有翼神兽。狭窄的赭黄与深红边线划定内侧正方形，周围留下宽阔的素色纸边。蓝金相间的圆形装饰锚定上方角落，卷曲螺旋则从下方角落向内回转。边框内塞满锈红、赭黄、浅青绿和蓝色卷草纹，几乎没有空白底面。神兽面向左侧，有长而尖的喙、小小的红圈眼，以及从头后升起的一簇红色角状羽冠。宽阔蓝颈向下弯入圆润胸部，细微明暗痕迹暗示层层鳞片或平顺羽毛。最大的特征是一只抬起的翅膀，横扫中央和右侧。强烈蓝色前缘弯过一排排珊瑚粉羽根，长长的青绿色外层羽毛向右边框紧密堆叠。深墨线分开每根羽毛，细平行笔痕让翅膀有了体积。翅下，紧凑躯干由两条长蓝腿支撑。爪足张开在内框底边，一只在左，一只伸向右侧螺旋。肩部的卷曲花纹形体及身体后方几片蓝色叶状形增加装饰的复杂性。身体与卷纹互相遮挡，却不形成自然主义纵深，而像交织的徽章一样填满正方形。整张羊皮纸受光均匀平坦，局部浅亮部和较深墨线排线塑造神兽，而非单一投影。低饱和矿物蓝是主色，红橙色羽毛重音和金色螺旋为其添暖。表面有细微颗粒和轻微磨损，仿佛颜料沉入旧纸。整体构图把向左迈步的动势收束成由翅、爪、圆形和卷曲边框交织的装饰结。
style_prompt_en: The illuminated manuscript image combines matte mineral-like pigment, fine ink contours, and a warm aged-paper ground. A narrow square frame contains densely interwoven curved forms, with circular corner accents and repeated scrolls organizing the crowded space. Blue and teal occupy the largest linked shapes, while coral pink, rust red, and ochre highlight selected inner segments. Individual parts are separated by decisive dark lines and close parallel hatching, giving local relief without establishing modern deep perspective. Flat even illumination preserves the clarity of each color plane; slight pigment wear and parchment grain make the surface tactile. Large sweeping arcs cross rows of much smaller repeated strokes, creating motion within a stable geometric enclosure. The edges remain intricate yet carefully bounded, so ornament feels lavish rather than chaotic. The overall effect is symbolic and jewel-like, with disciplined framing and layered handmade detail carrying the visual style across any chosen subject.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩绘手抄本图像结合哑光矿物颜料般色彩、细墨线轮廓和暖色旧纸底面。狭窄的方形边框容纳密集交织的弯曲形体，圆形角落重音和重复卷纹组织拥挤空间。蓝色与青绿色占据最大的相连形状，珊瑚粉、锈红和赭黄挑亮局部内侧区段。果断的深色线条与紧密平行排线分开各部分，提供局部浮雕感，却不建立现代式深透视。平坦均匀的光线保留各色面的清晰度；轻微颜料磨损和羊皮纸颗粒让表面可触。巨大的扫动弧线交叉许多更小的重复笔痕，在稳定几何围框中产生运动。边缘复杂却受谨慎约束，因此装饰显得华美而非混乱。整体效果象征性强且如珠宝般精致，严整框架与层叠手工细节使这一视觉风格可以承载不同主体。
theme_en: A blue winged mythical creature inside an ornate square manuscript frame
theme_zh: 华丽方形手抄本边框中的蓝色有翼神兽
name: Aberdeen Bestiary
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
